# Nakasendo Indoors

> The Nakasendo's indoor experience: the Nerikiri Challenge, a hands-on wagashi (Japanese sweets) workshop
> in Nagiso, Kiso Valley, Nagano, Japan. Run out of Kashiwaya guesthouse by From Scratch LLC.

## The Nerikiri Challenge

- What: shape nerikiri — delicate seasonal Japanese sweets made from white-bean paste — by an irori hearth
  inside a century-old kura storehouse, then eat them with matcha.
- Teacher: Makiko Koide, Kiso-born licensed confectioner (seika eiseishi), 3 years' training in Tokyo.
  Interpreted into English. No experience needed; families welcome.
- Length: about 2 hours. Also a one-hour Morning Session, 8:30–9:30 (free shuttle for Kashiwaya guests).
- Days: any day of the week.
- Booking: at least 2 days ahead. First message us on WhatsApp or LINE with your preferred date and group size.
- Price (opening offer): ¥2,000 per group + ¥2,000 per person (e.g. ¥6,000 for two).
- Entirely indoors, so it works in any weather.
